About Me

I am a Computer Science and Engineering student at American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB), expected to graduate in 2029. I completed my SSC in Science at Sabujbagh Government High School in 2022 and my HSC in Science at Sabujbagh Government College in 2024, with a GPA of 5.00 in both.

I have a foundation in Java, object-oriented programming and HTML/CSS. For my Object Oriented Programming 1 course I built a Java Swing desktop app for a bike shop, and for Business Communication I built this portfolio website.

Outside class, I have led student organizations and coordinated teams. I am a researcher at the AIUB Research and Development Club and Managing Secretary at AlokNir Foundation.
